Package comp3607.group10.telemetry.model

Class DetailKeys

java.lang.Object
comp3607.group10.telemetry.model.DetailKeys
public class DetailKeys extends Object
The names used for the extra values (details) stored with each event, so every class spells them the same way.
Author:
Anushka Dwarika
